seo.title: Size guide | Awrea Paris
seo.description: The Awrea Paris size guide: bust, waist and hip measurements in centimetres, how to take your measurements and help in finding your size.

chapeau: Each piece is made in the size you choose. Your measurements, taken against the skin, lead you to the right one.

tableau.aConfirmer: Table to be confirmed by the Maison: these measurements may still change before the first deliveries.

mesures.conseil: Standing, in your underwear, with the tape measure lying flat against the skin, without pulling it tight.

liste.texte: Pass the tape measure around the fullest part of the bust, keeping it level.
Measure at the hollow of the waist, where the torso is narrowest.
Measure around the widest part of the hips, with your feet together.

trouver.texte: On the page of each piece, “Find my size” compares your three measurements with this table and with the cut of the piece, then suggests a size. For advice in person, the designer will see you by appointment.

cta.label: Find my size on a piece
